title: Creative Product Design under Brand Image Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2611.17762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial design requires creative visual exploration while satisfying constraints that are often product-specific and implicit. Existing text-to-image (T2I) approaches can generate creative designs through concept blending or multi-agent self-enhancement, but they provide limited mechanisms for ensuring that generated designs remain consistent with such constraints. We focus on brand image as a representative design constraint and propose a framework for brand-aware redesign generation. Given a product name, the framework constructs a brand image survey report that summarizes product and market information, derives a creative direction from the report, and integrates this direction into a self-enhancement loop in which generated images are critiqued and prompts are revised. We evaluate the framework on 50 redesign tasks across five product categories, comparing it with Naive T2I, IP-Adapter/IT-Blender, and unconstrained self-enhancem

translated_title: 品牌形象约束下的创意产品设计
translated_abstract: 工业设计需要在满足约束条件的同时进行创意性的视觉探索，而这些约束往往是产品特定的且隐性的。现有的文本生成图像（T2I）方法可以通过概念融合或多智能体自我增强来生成创意设计，但它们在确保生成设计与此类约束保持一致方面的机制较为有限。我们聚焦于品牌形象作为一种代表性的设计约束，提出了一个品牌感知的再设计生成框架。给定一个产品名称，该框架会构建一份品牌形象调研报告，总结产品和市场信息，从报告中推导出创意方向，并将该方向整合到自我增强循环中，在这个循环中对生成的图像进行评价并修订提示词。我们在五个产品类别的50个再设计任务上对该框架进行了评估，将其与朴素T2I、IP-Adapter/IT-Blender以及无约束的自我增强方法进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个品牌感知的产品再设计生成框架，通过构建品牌形象调研报告并将其创意方向整合进图像评价与提示词修订的自我增强循环中，从而确保生成的创意设计符合品牌形象约束。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a brand-aware redesign generation framework that ensures creative product designs adhere to brand image constraints by constructing brand image survey reports and integrating derived creative directions into a self-enhancement loop of image critique and prompt revision.
